CHAPTER_SENTINEL Readers compare observations carefully and record their methods so another reader can inspect the evidence and repeat the work.

SEARCH_SENTINEL Use this panel to select a collection and search the available volumes. Enter a phrase, choose the fields that should be included, and select a matching mode.
